scripts.translation: 我明明給了你 30 瓶棕櫚油，你該不會全弄丟了吧？

scripts.text: This is the palm tree oil which was in short supply. Be careful please. It was really hard to get this...
scripts.translation: 這就是之前短缺的棕櫚油，拿好。弄到這些可費了不少勁...

scripts.text: What happened? I didn't get a memo from Mr. Memo that he was going to send someone here.
scripts.translation: 怎麼回事？梅莫先生沒告訴我他會派人過來啊。

scripts.text: Hey, I've been waiting for you. I didn't know that Poby's injury would make my life so difficult.
scripts.translation: 嘿，我正等著你呢。波比受傷後，我才知道一個人幹活有多辛苦。

scripts.text: I'm ashamed to ask you this, but can you bring ^0000FF{0} pieces of oil palm nuts^000000 please?
scripts.translation: 真不好意思開口...能請你幫我帶來 個油棕果嗎？ ^0000FF{0}^000000

scripts.text: Once you bring the oil palm nuts, Mr. Memo will exchange them with oil.

scripts.text: Once you bring the {0} pieces of oil palm nuts, Mr. Memo will exchange them with oil.

scripts.translation: 正好  個油棕果。現在就把它們拿去榨油吧。 {0}

scripts.text: As I told you before, it is heavier than you might think, so be careful when carrying this.

scripts.translation: 我之前說過，這油比你想的沉，搬運時務必小心。

scripts.text: What's going on with Poby...? Why hasn't he come back...?
scripts.translation: 波比那邊怎麼樣了...？他怎麼還沒回來...？

scripts.text: - Seems that he is waiting for someone-
Why are you carrying so much?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: You're going to regret it if you are carrying so much.
scripts.translation: 帶這麼多東西，你遲早會後悔的。

scripts.text: I do not know you, but
are you a fan of mine?
I'm Poby, the best fruit hunter in the Jaty tribe.
scripts.translation: 嗎？我是波比，賈提部落最棒的水果獵人。

scripts.text: Ah! Mr. Lero made you come here. I can't move because I hurt my back while climbing a tree.
scripts.translation: 啊！萊羅先生讓你來的啊。我爬樹時傷了腰，現在動不了。

scripts.text: And I've still never had a girlfriend...
scripts.translation: 而且我到現在連女朋友都沒有...

scripts.text: Ah! Sorry. Tell Mr. Lero that I will go back if I can find a way to move.
scripts.translation: 啊！抱歉。請告訴萊羅先生，等我想到辦法能動了，就會回去。

scripts.text: I can't move at all 'cuz of this backache...
Ah! Sorry. Tell Mr. Lero that I will go back if I can find a way to move.
scripts.translation: 啊！抱歉。請告訴萊羅先生，等我想到辦法能動了，就會回去。

scripts.text: I can't move at all 'cuz of this backache...
You got all the fruits. Bring them to Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation: 果子都採齊了。帶去交給萊羅先生吧。

scripts.text: It's easiest for beginners like you to shake or kick the tree.
scripts.translation: 像你這樣的新手，搖樹或踢樹最容易採到果子。

scripts.text: It might be dangerous, so always wear a ^0000FFSafety Helmet^000000.
scripts.translation: 這可能有危險，記得戴上安全帽。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Gather ^FF000060 ^0000FFPalm Oil Fruit^000000 and bring them to Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation: 收集 60 個油棕果，帶給萊羅先生。 ^FF0000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: ...you're back! You plan to catch ^0000FFPalm Oil Fruit^000000 instead of me, right?
scripts.translation: ...你回來了！是想替我去採油棕果吧？ ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: It is hard for beginners to catch the fruit like me. No it's impossible.
scripts.translation: 像我這樣採果子，新手可做不到。不，根本不可能。

scripts.text: Masters usually climb the tree to catch the fruit, but you're a beginner...
scripts.translation: 老手通常會爬上樹採果子，可你還是個新手...

scripts.text: It's easiest for beginners to shake or kick the tree. It might be dangerous, so remember to wear a ^0000FFSafety Helmet^000000.
scripts.translation: 對新手來說，搖樹或踢樹最容易採到果子。不過有危險，記得戴上安全帽。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Ok! Gather ^FF000060^0000FF ^0000FFPalm Oil Fruit^000000 and bring that amount to Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation: 好！收集 60 個 油棕果，按這個數量帶去交給萊羅先生。 ^FF0000^0000FF^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Oh! {0}, we meet again. What's going on?
Good work! Be careful while delivering them~
scripts.translation: [波比]幹得好！送過去時小心點~
哦！，又見面了。怎麼了？- 你向他說明了情況。 -

scripts.text: Right... I owed Memo's grandfather. Wait, I hid some oil around here.
scripts.translation: 對了...我還欠梅莫的祖父一些東西。等等，我記得在這附近藏了些油。

scripts.text: I have some, but you seem to have too much stuff with you.
scripts.translation: 我這兒是有一些，不過你身上好像帶了太多東西。

scripts.text: Ah! Here is another one. Take care not to lose it again. And keep it a secret from Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation: 啊！這裡還有一份。別再弄丟了。還有，可別告訴萊羅先生。

scripts.text: I want to know how to get fruit.
I'm taking a walk because I think it will make my back ache less.
scripts.translation: 我在散步，想著這樣也許能緩解腰痛。

scripts.text: It's easiest for beginners to shake or kick the tree.
scripts.translation: 對新手來說，搖樹或踢樹最容易採到果子。

scripts.text: It might be dangerous, so always wear a ^0000FFSafety Helmet^000000.
scripts.translation: 這可能有危險，記得戴上安全帽。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Ah~ my freakin' back is killing me.
scripts.translation: 啊~ 這該死的腰疼得要命。

scripts.text: There's a palm tree with fruits and flowers hanging from its branches.
scripts.translation: 一棵棕櫚樹，枝頭掛著果實和花朵

scripts.text: Be sure to wear a Safety Helmet while trying to pick the fruit.
You can kick or shake it.
What do you want to do?
You kick the palm tree swiftly with all you might.
scripts.translation: 你卯足全力，迅速踢了棕櫚樹一腳。

scripts.text: something falls on your head, but since you're wearing a Safety Helmet you're safe and sound.
scripts.translation: 有東西砸到了你的頭，不過你戴著安全帽，安然無恙。

scripts.text: something smashes down on your head, right where that soft spot is, $#*@! that's a one in a million shot.
scripts.translation: 有東西正中你的腦袋，偏偏砸在最脆弱的地方。該死！這命中率簡直百萬分之一。

scripts.text: tons of ^0000FFOil Palm Fruit^000000 crashes down from the tree.
scripts.translation: 大量油棕果從樹上砸落下來。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: - You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. -
scripts.translation: -- 你的物品太多，背包空間不足，無法領取獎勵。

scripts.text: - Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge. -
scripts.translation: -- 請騰出背包空間後，再回來接受挑戰。 -

scripts.text: Where in the hell am I? Everybody here is avoiding me.
scripts.translation: 我到底到了什麼鬼地方？這裡的人都躲著我。

scripts.text: Hey there, young {0}~ Are you from around here?
scripts.translation: 嘿，年輕的~ 你是本地人嗎？ {0}

scripts.text: - He seems to be asking for the Island name. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎是在問這座島的名字。 -

scripts.text: This is Dewata Island? You're sure this is Dewata Island?
scripts.translation: 這裡是德瓦他島？你確定這兒是德瓦他島？

scripts.text: - The old man started to laugh like a crazy person after hearing the name of the Island. You decide to ask a little bit later. -
scripts.translation: - 老人聽到島名後突然像瘋了一樣大笑。你決定過一會兒再問他。 -

scripts.text: - The old man gave a deep sigh of resignation and continued speaking. -
scripts.translation: - 老人無奈地長嘆一聲，接著說了下去。 -

scripts.text: Damn... My plan is ruined. I invested all my fortunes to get there, but I failed. I can't do anything now, my boat has been wrecked.
scripts.translation: 該死...我的計劃全泡湯了。我把所有積蓄都投進去，結果還是沒能找到。現在船也遇難了，我什麼都做不了。

scripts.text: - The old man starts to cry. -

scripts.translation: - 你覺得有些尷尬，趕緊離開了。 -

scripts.text: Oh... Sorry~ Sorry. I was so happy that I finally arrived at Dewata Island.
scripts.translation: 哦...抱歉~抱歉。我太高興了，終於抵達德瓦他島。

scripts.text: This is not a short story. Oh! I have to introduce myself first. I am Mastersmith Gatti, also an Adventurer.
scripts.translation: 說來話長。啊，我得先自我介紹。我是神工匠加蒂，也是一名冒險者。

scripts.text: I found a mysterious Weapon blueprint, but I don't remember exactly when I acquired it.
scripts.translation: 我找到了一張神秘的武器設計圖，不過記不清具體是什麼時候得到的了。

scripts.text: Yes! I traveled all around to find the materials for the weapon, but...
scripts.translation: 沒錯！我跑遍各地尋找打造這把武器的材料，可是...

scripts.text: I couldn't find the last material anywhere.
scripts.translation: 我怎麼也找不到最後一種材料。

scripts.text: I was about to give up, but there was some fine print on the blueprint saying that it could be found on the Dewata Island.
scripts.translation: 我都快放棄了，才發現設計圖上有一行小字，說這種材料可以在德瓦他島找到。

scripts.text: I don't know why somebody put such an important thing in fine print. Anyway, after reading that, I invested all my fortunes to find that Island.
scripts.translation: 這麼重要的資訊，為什麼要用小字寫呢？總之，看到之後，我就花光了積蓄去找這座島。

scripts.text: This island is strange. I arrived here a week ago, and everybody here has been avoiding me.
scripts.translation: 這座島真奇怪。我一週前就到了，可這裡的人一直躲著我。

scripts.text: Last week was so hard, but you saved me by telling me this is Dewata Island.
scripts.translation: 上週可真難熬。幸好你告訴我這裡是德瓦他島，幫了我

scripts.text: Thank you for telling me, and thank you for passing here at just the right time.
scripts.translation: 大忙。謝謝你告知我實情，也謝謝你恰好在那時路過。

scripts.text: Well... There was a little problem of my ship getting wrecked, but that's neither here nor there.
scripts.translation: 唉...雖然我的船也出了點意外，沉了，不過先不說這個。

scripts.text: Now that I found out this is Dewata Island, I should find the material for this great weapon.
scripts.translation: 既然知道這裡是德瓦他島，我就該去找打造這把神兵的材料了。

scripts.text: Ah! the material that I am looking for is Comodo Leather.
scripts.translation: 啊！我要找的材料是科摩多龍皮。

scripts.text: Yes. In the blueprint, it's written that only the recognized few of the Dewata Natives are worthy enough to fight against the Comodo Dragon.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。設計圖上說，只有少數得到德瓦他原住民認可的人，才有資格挑戰科摩多龍。

scripts.text: In order to fight the Comodo Dragon, you have to get recognized by the natives. I assume it'll be hard to get the recognition.
scripts.translation: 要挑戰科摩多龍，必須先得到原住民的認可。看來這認可不容易拿到。

scripts.text: Let me ask you a favor. If you get the recognition first, please don't forget to visit me.
scripts.translation: 拜託你一件事。如果你先得到認可，別忘了回來找我。

scripts.text: Lady, you possess a strong energy.
scripts.translation: 女士，您身上有股強大的氣
您身上有股強大的氣息。您在這座島上見過一種叫科摩多龍的魔物嗎？

scripts.text: Have you seen a monster called a Comodo Dragon on this Island?
scripts.translation: 息。您在這座島上見過一種叫科摩多龍的魔物嗎？

scripts.text: I'm so lucky to have met you. This is going so well.
scripts.translation: ？能遇見您真是太幸運了，事情進展得真順利。

scripts.text: The weapon material that I was looking for is ^0000FFComodo Leather^000000. Bring me 100 of them, and I will make you a fancy weapon.
scripts.translation: 我要找的武器材料是科摩多龍皮。請給我 100 張，我就為您打造一把華麗的武器。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I heard Comodo Dragons are very powerful monsters. Please be careful.
scripts.translation: 聽說科摩多龍非常強大，請務必小心。

scripts.text: Did you get recognized by the natives?
scripts.translation: 你得到原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text: I guess not yet. I'm asking around everywhere, but I couldn't find a way to get recognized from natives. I don't know when I could finish making this weapon.
scripts.translation: 看來還沒有。我到處打聽，卻始終找不到獲得原住民認可的辦法。也不知道何時才能把這把武器做出來。

scripts.text: If you get the recognition before me, please DON'T forget to visit me.
scripts.translation: 如果你比我先得到認可，千萬別忘了回來找我。

scripts.text: So, did you get recognized by the natives?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你得到原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text: Lady, you also possess a strong energy.
scripts.translation: 算等到了。女士，您身上也有股強

scripts.text: You also possess a strong energy.
scripts.translation: 哦，太好了！總算等到了。您身上也有股強大的氣息。您終於得到原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text: Did you finally get the recognition from natives?
scripts.translation: 大的氣息。您終於得到原住民的認可了嗎？

scripts.text: I was so lucky to meet you. Everything is going so well.
scripts.translation: 能遇到你真是太幸運了，一切都很順利。

scripts.text: I know I have no right to ask you for this, but meeting like this is a destiny...
scripts.translation: 我知道自己沒資格提出這種請求，不過我們的相遇一定是命運安排...

scripts.text: The weapon material that I so longed for is ^0000FFComodo Leather^000000. Please get me 100 of them.
scripts.translation: 我夢寐以求的武器材料就是科摩多龍皮。請幫我收集 100 張。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I'm so eager to make the weapon in the weapon blueprint.
scripts.translation: 我已經迫不及待想按照武器設計圖把武器做出來了。

scripts.text: Please, before my passion fades out.
scripts.translation: 拜託了，趁我的熱情還沒消退...

scripts.text: Oh! And Comodo Dragon is a very powerful monster, so please be careful.
scripts.translation: 對了！科摩多龍非常強大，千萬小心。

scripts.text: By the looks of your walk, you must have brought me 100 Comodo Leather. Hand it over to me.
scripts.translation: 看你走路的樣子，應該帶了 100 張科摩多龍皮吧？快交給我。

scripts.text: - Gatti takes the Comodo Leather from you. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂從你手中接過科摩多龍皮。 -

scripts.text: So, that is the Comodo Leather. But not enough.
scripts.translation: 這就是科摩多龍皮啊。不過，數量還不夠。

scripts.text: I know I'm asking you a favor, but I need 100 of them.
scripts.translation: 我知道是在麻煩你，但我需要 100 張。

scripts.text: Please be careful because Comodo Dragon is very powerful monster. And don't forget to bring me 100 Comodo Leather on your way back.
scripts.translation: 科摩多龍非常強大，務必小心。回來時別忘了帶 100 張科摩多龍皮給我。

scripts.text: Oh~ Look at this. How resilient... So soft.
scripts.translation: 哦~快看！真有韌性...摸起來又這麼柔軟。

scripts.text: Comodo Leather is the best material ever.
scripts.translation: 科摩多龍皮真是絕佳的材料。

scripts.text: Yes, how should I process this?
Or like that? Yes! This is the way!
scripts.translation: 還是那樣？對了！就該這麼做！

scripts.text: - Mastersmith Gatti is enjoying to process the Leathers you've brought to make the weapon. -
scripts.translation: - 神工匠加蒂正興致勃勃地加工你帶來的皮革，準備製作武器。

scripts.text: - You should wait a little while. -
Oh! Sorry, sorry! This leather is so interesting.
scripts.translation: 啊！抱歉抱歉！這皮革實在太有意思了。

scripts.text: I made a hilt out of the leather you brought me.
scripts.translation: 我用你帶來的皮革做了一個印度尼西亞短劍柄。

scripts.text: You don't know what a hilt is? That's what you call the handle of a weapon.
scripts.translation: 你不知道什麼是劍柄嗎？就是武器的握柄。

scripts.text: - Gatti shows a thing that looks like a handle of a weapon. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂拿出一個看起來像武器握柄的東西給你看。 -

scripts.text: I tried making it like what's written in the blueprint, but I need more material.
scripts.translation: 我試著按照設計圖來做，可是還需要更多材料。

scripts.text: Yes... To be frank with you, I ruined a lot of them trying different things.
scripts.translation: 是啊...坦白說，我試了好幾種做法，浪費了不少材料。

scripts.text: I know this is a lot to ask, but can you get me 100 more Comodo Leather, 20 Steel, and 10 Oridecon?
scripts.translation: 我知道這要求很多，不過你能再幫我找 100 張科摩多龍皮、20 塊鋼和 10 個神之金屬嗎？

scripts.text: I'll make you a best weapon ever.
scripts.translation: 我會給你打造一把最棒的武器。

scripts.text: Oh! I almost forgot. Don't forget to bring the hilt that I just made you.
scripts.translation: 啊！差點忘了。別忘了帶上我剛做好的短劍柄。

scripts.text: A weapon must have a handle.
You brought all the material already?
You were also curious about the finished weapon? Haha.
scripts.translation: 很好奇成品會是什麼樣吧？哈哈。

scripts.text: Hmm... I need more of those. If my ship didn't get wrecked, I could made it on my own, but...
scripts.translation: 嗯...還得再多準備些材料。要是我的船沒出事，我本可以自己去找，可是...

scripts.text: 100 Comodo Leather, 20 Steel, and 10 Oridecon are what I need.
scripts.translation: 我需要 100 張科摩多龍皮、20 塊鋼和 10 個神之金屬。

scripts.text: If you bring them all, I'll make the best weapon ever.
scripts.translation: 這些材料都湊齊的話，我就給你打造一把最棒的武器。

scripts.text: Great! We have enough. Wait a little.
scripts.translation: 太好了！材料夠了。稍等一會兒。

scripts.text: I finished making the weapon. This is called Caress according to the blueprint.
scripts.translation: 武器做好了。設計圖上說，它的名字叫“印度尼西亞短劍”。

scripts.text: I keep finding new stuffs when I lay my eyes on this blueprint.
scripts.translation: 每次看這張設計圖，我都能發現新的細節。

scripts.text: Now, I learned how to make the weapon, ask me any time if you need it.
scripts.translation: 現在我已經學會怎麼打造這把武器了。你需要的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text: So, how's the Caress that I made you?
scripts.translation: 我給你打造的印度尼西亞短劍用得怎麼樣
我還想要一把印度尼西亞短劍。

scripts.text: Yes, yes of course it's great.
I made that weapon so it should be good.
scripts.translation: 然不錯。畢竟是我打造的，肯定不會差。

scripts.text: You only have a Hilt. You'll need to bring me 10 Oridecon, 20 Steel, and 70 Comodo Leather.
scripts.translation: ，我給你打造的印度尼西亞短劍用得怎麼樣？[加蒂]你手上只有短劍柄。還需要給我 10 個神之金屬、20 塊鋼和 70 張科摩多龍皮。

scripts.text: If you bring them, I'll make a brand new Caress.
scripts.translation: 把材料帶來，我就給你打造一把全新的印度尼西亞短劍。

scripts.text: You have all the materials. Wait just a little.
scripts.translation: ，我給你打造的印度尼西亞短劍用得怎麼樣？[加蒂]材料都齊了。稍等一會兒。

scripts.text: Here is the Caress! Ask me any time.
scripts.translation: 印度尼西亞短劍做好了！有需要隨時來找我。

scripts.text: You want me to make one more Caress for you? In that case I need a Hilt. 50 Comodo Leather, and 1 Log. These are what I need to make a Hilt.
scripts.translation: ，我給你打造的印度尼西亞短劍用得怎麼樣？[加蒂]還想再要一把印度尼西亞短劍嗎？那我需要一個短劍柄、50 張科摩多龍皮和 1 根木材來製作短劍柄。

scripts.text: You brought the material for the Hilt. I'll make it right away.
scripts.translation: ，我給你打造的印度尼西亞短劍用得怎麼樣？[加蒂]短劍柄的材料帶來了嗎？我這就開始製作。

scripts.text: Put this here, and process it like this...
scripts.translation: 把這個放在這裡，再這樣加工...

scripts.text: Here you go. I can make a Caress if you bring me 10 Oridecon, 20 Steel, and 70 Comodo Leather.
scripts.translation: 給你。帶來 10 個神之金屬、20 塊鋼和 70 張科摩多龍皮，我就能給你打造印度尼西亞短劍。

scripts.text: So, you want to reinforce your weapon? The weapon gets broken from time to time during the process, but it doesn't happen that often.
scripts.translation: ，我給你打造的印度尼西亞短劍用得怎麼樣？[加蒂]想強化武器嗎？強化時偶爾會損壞武器，不過這種情況不常見。[加蒂]想強化印度尼西亞短劍的話，帶上短劍和 100,000 Zeny 來找我就行。

scripts.text: Whenever you want to reinforce the Caress, just bring me the Caress and 100,000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 想強化印度尼西亞短劍的話，帶上短劍和

scripts.text: If you want to do it, I'll have to tell you some cautionary things before reinforcing the Caress.
scripts.translation: ，我給你打造的印度尼西亞短劍用得怎麼樣？[加蒂]想強化武器嗎？強化時偶爾會損壞武器，不過這種情況不常見。[加蒂]如果你決定強化印度尼西亞短劍，我得先告訴你一些注意事項。

scripts.text: ^FF0000First!^009977 I need 1 Caress and 100,000 zeny to reinforce the Caress. As you know, I don't have any money right now because my ship got wrecked.^000000
scripts.translation: 第一！強化需要 1 把印度尼西亞短劍和 100,000 Zeny。你也知道，我的船沉了，現在身無分文。 ^FF0000^009977^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Second!^009977 If you have a Caress that is refined or inserted with cards in your inventory which you don't want to reinforce, it could get destroyed or it's upgrades can get changed during the reinforcing process.
scripts.translation: 第二！如果背包裡有你不想強化、已經精煉或插了卡片的印度尼西亞短劍，它們在強化過程中可能會損壞，或改變精煉等級。 ^FF0000^009977

scripts.text: If you don't want that to happen, put the refined Caress elsewhere before the reinforcing.^000000
scripts.translation: 不想發生這種事的話，強化前請先把已經精煉的短劍收好。 ^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Third!^009977 Sometimes reinforcing fails. The weapon doesn't get destroyed every time you fail. However you should know that the weapon gets destroyed from time to time if you fail.^000000
scripts.translation: 第三！強化有時會失敗。失敗並不一定會損壞武器，但也可能導致武器損壞，這點你要記住。 ^FF0000^009977^000000

scripts.text: Whenever you want to reinforce the Caress, just bring me the Caress and 100,000 zeny.
You don't have all the materials. It's impossible to reinforce if you don't have them all. If you want to reinforce, bring 100,000 zeny and 1 Caress.
scripts.translation: 材料還沒帶齊，沒法強化。想強化的話，請帶上 100,000 Zeny 和 1 把印度尼西亞短劍。

scripts.text: Oh my~~ Almost succeeded... But failed. Sorry, sorry...
scripts.translation: 哎呀~~ 差一點就成功了...可惜還是失敗了。抱歉抱歉...

scripts.text: Reinforcing the Caress has been successful. See you later.
scripts.translation: 印度尼西亞短劍強化成功了。下次再見。
